description: This file defines the 'Context' class managing browser contexts, tabs, and related operations in Playwright's MCP (Multi-Channel Protocol) implementation, including context creation, tab management, request interception, and input recording.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages browser contexts, tabs, and related operations, including context creation, tab management, request interception, and tracing.

classes.name: InputRecorder
classes.description: Handles recording user input actions within a browser context for session logging.

methods.name: disposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all existing contexts.

methods.name: tabs
methods.description: Returns the list of current tabs.

methods.name: currentTab
methods.description: Returns the current active tab.

methods.name: currentTabOrDie
methods.description: Returns the current tab or throws an error if none is active.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates and returns a new tab.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Selects a tab by index and makes it active.

methods.name: ensureTab
methods.description: Ensures there is an active tab, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: closeTab
methods.description: Closes a specified tab and returns its URL.

methods.name: outputFile
methods.description: Generates an output file path based on the configuration.

methods.name: _onPageCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new page and associates it with a tab.

methods.name: _onPageClosed
methods.description: Handles the closing of a page and updates tab list.

methods.name: closeBrowserContext
methods.description: Closes the current browser context.

methods.name: isRunningTool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is currently running.

methods.name: setRunningTool
methods.description: Sets the name of the currently running tool.

methods.name: _closeBrowserContextImpl
methods.description: Implementation detail for closing the browser context, including stopping tracing.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the context, aborting operations and closing the browser context.

methods.name: _setupRequestInterception
methods.description: Configures network request interception based on allowed and blocked origins.

methods.name: ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Ensures a browser context exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: _ensureBrowserContext
methods.description: Internal method to manage browser context promise.

methods.name: _setupBrowserContext
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new browser context, including request interception and tracing.

methods.name: lookupSecret
methods.description: Retrieves secret values from configuration or environment.
